Who I am

About Me

I'm S. Kashif Kamran Nawaz, an engineering student passionate about building software that actually does something useful. My background spans computer science foundations and a deep interest in AI and machine learning systems.

I started with a Diploma in Computer Science and Engineering, which gave me a solid base in programming and systems. Now I'm pursuing a B.E. in Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning, diving deeper into the field I care most about.

I enjoy working on end-to-end projects — from writing the first line of code to having something that actually runs and makes sense. Python is my go-to, but I'm comfortable picking up whatever the project needs.

"I want to work on problems where intelligent systems make a real difference — building models that are not just academically interesting but practically useful. Looking for opportunities where I can keep learning while contributing meaningfully."
